core_claim.P: When launchFor() computes the assetToken liquidity for initial liquidity provision using the formula with K, assetRate, and supply, relying on Solidity integer division
core_claim.I: The calculated liquidity amount must equal the mathematically precise value intended by the bonding curve formula
core_claim.V: Integer division truncates remainders at the first division (K * 10000) / assetRate and in the divisions within (((k * 10000 ether) / supply) * 1 ether) / 10000, so the calculated liquidity deviates from the precise value

distinct_impacts.description: The new token is listed on the DEX pair at an initial price different from what the bonding curve intends, because the supply-to-liquidity ratio determines the initial price.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: An incorrect `liquidity` value means the token is listed at a price different from what the bonding curve intends.

distinct_impacts.description: The bonding curve's mathematical relationship between token supply, price, and reserves is broken, potentially affecting fairness and predictability for early participants and liquidity providers.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: Truncation breaks this invariant, potentially affecting the fairness and predictability of the bonding mechanism for early participants and liquidity providers.

distinct_impacts.description: Subsequent trades against a pool initialized with an incorrect liquidity ratio may experience unexpected slippage relative to the theoretical bonding curve price.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: Subsequent trades interacting with a pool initialized with an incorrect liquidity ratio may experience unexpected slippage compared to the theoretical bonding curve price.

distinct_impacts.description: Integer division truncates remainders at the first division and within the second line's divisions, losing fractional parts when the intermediate numerator is not perfectly divisible by the denominator.
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: If the intermediate numerator is not perfectly divisible by the denominator at any of these steps, the fractional part is lost.
